content:
Widow’s Bay season finale airs this week on Apple TV, and Apple just posted a short video teasing what’s coming.

Widow’s Bay finale teaser shows Mayor Loftis visiting important resident’s home

One of Apple TV’s most unique and surprising breakout hits of the year is Widow’s Bay.

The series, against all odds, deftly combines comedy and horror in a genre-defying, very original show.

Critics love the show, and viewers clearly do too, as Widow’s Bay has regularly been #1 in Apple TV’s top charts.

Widow’s Bay’s season 1 finale airs this Tuesday night, June 16 at 9:00 p.m. ET / 6:00 p.m. PT.

Here’s the teaser video Apple posted today on X:

The season finale is titled, “We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!” and comes with this episode description:

Per the Apple TV app, the finale will run 48 minutes long, making it the longest episode of the season.

Last week Widow’s Bay was officially renewed for season 2. Its creator, Katie Dippold, also struck a new multiyear overall deal for future Apple TV projects.

You can watch Widow’s Bay here on Apple TV.

Have you been watching Widow’s Bay? What’s your take on the series? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
